scope: Prospective deployment prerequisite only; no scientific question, official draw, hidden evaluation or capability score.
historical_availability_observation: On 2026-10-03 the prior Hugging Face hub directory and recorded weight path were absent, port 8081 had no listener, and no llama/ollama/mlx/vllm process was found. Historical availability records remain unchanged.

download.authentication: none; curl --disable first argument, empty environment apart from PATH; no Hugging Face SDK or token/config access

launch_environment: env -i; PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; fresh check HOME; DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH exactly library_directory

request.system_prompt: This is an environment transport check, not a research task. Use the supplied tool once to record the exact marker provided by the user. Do not add analysis or perform any other work.

tool.name: record_environment_receipt
tool.description: Record one opaque transport marker. This tool does not execute research or change files.

pre_call_checks: Verify weights, server and library hashes, observed model alias/path, template hash, one slot, 131072 context and server decoding values. Save /props and /v1/models before the single request. A mismatch stops without a model call.
records: Plan, request dataclass, native parsed response, observations and stdout/stderr hashes. Parsed native JSON is not a raw HTTP byte capture. Failed preparation/start/request remains recorded with no automatic retry.
cleanup: Terminate only the server started for this check; verify its PID and port listener are gone. Leave peer processes, caches and historical records untouched; retain the verified ignored weight file.
limitations: Allocation and a short forced-tool request do not validate a 131k-token input, free tool selection, long-session recovery, scientific capacity, matched arms, a study RNG schedule or publication efficacy. The setup seed is not a main-study seed. Source completeness, independent authority, task roster, actual arm matching and release rights remain open.
